entries.example: We succeeded in persuading a lot of people to join our protest.

entries.def: [manage, but not succeed, may have a direct object in this meaning]

entries.def: [both are used with quantity phrases such as 'a lot' / 'a little'; accomplish is rather formal.]
entries.example: We've achieved / accomplished a great deal in the last year.

entries.def: [achieve is more common than accomplish with nouns expressing goals and ambitions]
entries.example: The company has achieved all its goals/aims/targets for this year.
